series_kind_note: This series is the DAY-AHEAD TOTAL LOAD FORECAST published by the TSOs (ENTSO-E article 6.1.b), not measured actual load. Actual total load (6.1.a) is not published on this site until ENTSO-E confirms its re-use terms in writing.
status_note: Observing only: figures are collected and published, but no good/bad criterion has been defined for this edition (criteria are frozen as versioned definitions before use; none exists for the EU edition as of 2026-09-03). Do not infer thresholds.
scope_note: EU27 aggregate = simple sum of the day-ahead total load forecast over one area per member state (27 areas listed in areas_definition; CET/CEST calendar day; MWh = MW x resolution). Non-member areas (including the United Kingdom, Norway, Switzerland, the Western Balkans) are excluded. A day with any missing area is never final: value_status stays provisional and areas_missing / missing_area_codes record the gap.
value_status_note: value_status=final means fetched on a CET/CEST date later than the observation day with no missing area; provisional otherwise (may still be revised or completed on a later refetch). retrieved_retrospectively=true marks backfilled history retrieved after the series went live, kept apart from day-by-day observation.
